scoring_justification: The checker recomputes bulk band edges, surface velocities, and effective constants directly from the transfer matrix and averaging formulas; T1 is feasible and used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Material constants (Table 1 of the paper) and the transfer-matrix / effective-medium formulas, all encoded as code constants and functions; no external file needed.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and equations (2.5), (2.7), Appendix, Section 3.3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the paper's stated parameters and analytical expressions into Python code.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact physical constants and paper-derived formulas used in the reference computation; no synthetic or guessed values.

outputs.description: Bulk band-edge frequencies for the first two SH bands; the hidden checker will recompute the transfer matrix and compare the band edges within a relative tolerance.

Surface wave phase velocities for selected k∥D values; the hidden checker will recompute the surface wave conditions and compare velocities within a relative tolerance. NaN entries are allowed when a mode does not exist.
Effective medium constants; the hidden checker will compute the expected values from the material parameters and compare them with an absolute tolerance.

steps.description: Recompute bulk band edges for each agent-reported k∥D and compare within relative tolerance 1e-4.
Recompute surface wave phase velocities at the specified k∥D values and compare within relative tolerance 1e-4; NaN entries are skipped.
Compare effective constants against expected values derived from the averaging formulas, absolute tolerance 1e-3 in original units.
